verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
No other foundation can be laid
No other name by which I am saved
(Jesus of Nazareth)

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Great is the mystery
The fullness of deity
Dwelling in Your body

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I have seen the consummation of all perfection
And it’s You, it’s You, Jesus

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
Jesus, You are beautiful
Wonderful, beautiful

verse.name: b3
verse.lines:
Through You all things were made
You hold all things together
(Beautiful mystery
You wrapped Yourself in a garment of flesh for me)
